entry.description: A distinct map insertion exceeds that map's configured pair limit. Zero or omitted selects no limit. Counts and bar index are engine-owned context; code is the fixed TradingView identifier RE10070.
english: Error on bar {bar_index}: A map cannot have more than {maxSize} key-value pairs. The current size is {currSize}.

entry.description: A reached dynamic runtime context exceeded its explicitly configured history storage budget. configured, used and needed are the typed exception's exact uint64_t byte fields: the configured bound, ownership before the refused operation, and its additional required ownership. Each is a canonical unsigned decimal string from 0 through 18446744073709551615, without a sign, whitespace or leading zeroes except 0 itself. These counters do not use the host run-quota domain. No budget is imposed by the resident spill threshold or by the default absent budget.

A hard runtime history budget could not be enforced because the owned storage observation is incomplete. unsupported_flags is the actual uint64_t unsupported bit mask, including unknown bits. resident_metadata_bytes_lower_bound, resident_payload_bytes_lower_bound and backing_bytes_lower_bound are the observed category lower bounds, never an exact or usable total; categories can be saturated when overflow is true. These four uint64_t fields are canonical unsigned decimal strings from 0 through 18446744073709551615, without a sign, whitespace or leading zeroes except 0 itself. overflow is the observation's actual Boolean. No configured, used or needed byte count is inferred from an incomplete observation, even with a UINT64_MAX budget.
english: runtime context owned storage observation is incomplete
